title: 2026 UK CBAM actual-emissions system-boundary QA controls

sources.title: CBAM force of law notice and reference document

facts.source_fact: System boundaries define relevant production processes for determining embodied direct emissions.
The same system-boundary parameters apply to actual MRV and default emissions values.
facts.expected_handling: Keep boundary rule consistent across methods.

facts.source_fact: Emissions must be attributed to production processes.
Liable persons may need information from operators of installations producing imported CBAM goods.
Direct emissions include heating and cooling consumed in production regardless of whether produced on or off site.
Complex goods include embodied direct emissions of relevant precursor goods.
System boundaries include directly or indirectly linked production processes and relevant precursor emissions.
Functional units are generally tonnes under the same commodity code, with defined exceptions such as nitrogen content and clinker.
The accompanying force-of-law notice was still draft and not yet in force when published in July 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not present the draft notice as already commenced law.
